The root SCC is exactly forward reachability intersected with reverse reachability, so checking that entire component is sufficient and necessary without a spatial cutoff. Exhaustive exact tests for p=9 and 18 enumerate respectively 31 and 973 possible center time words; the root components of sizes 3 and 27 are the threefold temporal lifts of the p=3 and p=6 root components. Hence the full finite-support fixed-point equalities follow. The attached code checks all eight rule entries, uses two independently derived edge-generation implementations, compares their complete reachability sets and edge totals, and verifies example least periods 3 and 6. No finite experiment is used as an infinite spatial proof without the exact graph reduction.
